stageA2_sources.reused_pattern: After factor-squareclass descent, isolate the remaining source reconstruction square as a new genus-one quartic; compute binary-quartic invariants and its Jacobian before further MW machinery.

binary_quartic.twist_species: After rational Weierstrass scaling, d1 depends only on squareclass n=sf(2*delta1*delta2); d2 depends only on n=sf(delta1*delta2). Signs do not affect the Jacobian coefficient.

rank_zero_closure_rules.d1: The reconstruction quartic always has four rational axis points R=0 or S=0. If its Jacobian has rank 0 and torsion order 4, these are all rational points; U=0 or V=0 then maps only to receiver torsion/origin.
rank_zero_closure_rules.d2_e1: If sf(delta1*delta2)=+/-1, the quartic is Q-isomorphic to W^2=2(R^4+S^4). It has four explicit rational points R/S=+/-1 with W/S^2=+/-2. If the Jacobian has rank 0 and torsion order 4, these are complete. Returning through the rational square rescaling gives U/V=+/-1, hence t in {0,1/2,1,infinity}, exactly the audited order-4 receiver poles.
